evidence.claim: In 1854, Calhoun defeated Rumsey, across the river, in the contest to become the new McLean County seat.

evidence.claim: Before it was Sacramento, this place was Crossroads, with a post office called Social Hill.
evidence.quote: The first community at the site was known as "Crossroads", but the post office established in 1852 was named "Social Hill".

evidence.claim: George L. Helm platted and renamed the town in 1854.
